test_transition_edge_cases: test the EdgeCaseTransition class handles None, empty strings, empty collections, zero, and False values gracefully
test_unicode_handling: test the transition system handles Unicode characters, emojis, control characters, and special symbols without corruption
test_error_scenarios: test the ErrorProneTransition class raises TransitionValidationError during validation and RuntimeError during transition execution
test_registry_operations: test the transition_registry handles duplicate registrations, unusual entity names, and nonexistent lookups correctly
test_concurrent_errors: test the transition system handles simultaneous errors from multiple threads without data races or crashes
